Hi Michelangelo,

Thanks for checking in. I found your Magic Miner 40T order, Shop····. It's paid and hasn't shipped yet.

I can't honestly promise November 21. I'm sorry nobody wrote to you about this sooner. The first run of units was held up when Magic Miner stopped production to fix a control board issue. That's fixed now and the final version is approved. Production isn't split into batches any more. All 300 units are being built and shipped together, so your batch 6 date doesn't apply the way it did when you ordered. Magic Miner expected the units to leave the factory on November 12, but they haven't reached our warehouse yet. We set dates we couldn't keep and didn't keep you updated, and that's on us.

I've asked the team for the current date. They're back tomorrow at 10am ET and will email you the answer at the address on your order. You can follow the shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status. When your miner ships, we'll email you the tracking number.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

handoffs: Cannot confirm Nov 21 and have no newer date to give; told him the team confirms
